paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: a compact top-right radar of running sessions, pending approvals and recent failures, wi
th one-click session switching.
# dsh-session-radar

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows **what is
happening across your sessions** in one small pill at
the top-right corner of the frame:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Click it to open the list; click a row to switch to that session. When nothing is running, waiting
o
r failing, the widget renders nothing at all.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it shows
| State | Meaning | Source |
| **等审批** | the session has a pending approval (badge names the tool and extra count) | `approval/as

ked`, `approval/decided` |
| **运行中** | a turn is open, or a sub-agent is still running for this root

session | `turn/start`, `turn/end` |
| **失败** | the last turn ended with an `error` reason | `turn/

end.reason.kind` |
| **完成** | finished within `recentMs` (30 min by default) | `turn/end` |
| **子代理*
* | `+N 子代理` badge counts running child sessions | `session.header.parentSession` |

- Titles come from the durable `session/title` events, so no projection read is involved.
- Sub-agen

t sessions are aggregated into their root row instead of cluttering the list.
- Ordering is delibera

te: approvals first, then running, failures, finished — newest first within
each group.
## Requirements

- A DSH client that composes the client `uiWorkspace` service (used to switch sessions) and
`webServ

er` (the Host route). The Desktop client and `dsh web` both do.
- Node 20+ only for the test/install
scripts; the plugin has **no build step**.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Configuration
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `widgets.radar` | `true` | Register the pill and panel |
| `recentMs` | `1800000` | How long a fin

ished session stays listed |
| `maxRows` | `8` | Maximum rows published |
| `pollMs` | `2000` | Brow
ser poll interval (Host hint) |
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**Why `shell.overlay`?** It is a frame-wide list seat with `replaceRisk: none`, so a fresh `id`
sits

beside the shipped overlay entries instead of replacing one. The pill is positioned with
`var(--dsh

-frame-overlay-top, 44px)`, which keeps it below the Windows caption strip and the macOS
traffic lig

me-overlay-top, 44px)`, which keeps it below the Windows caption strip and the macOS
traffic lights.

**Why a Host half?** A client plugin only sees the session it is bound to. The cross-session view
ne
eds the global `session/event` stream, which only the Host receives.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Script | What it pins |
| `scripts/client-spec.mjs` | pill copy and tone, row ordering, per-state meta text, title fallback,

sub-agent badge, elapsed formatting, injected switches |
| `scripts/client-smoke.mjs` | bundle cont

ract, overlay registration, the radar switch |
| `scripts/host-smoke.mjs` | state ordering and count

s, approval lifecycle, sub-agent aggregation, `maxRows`, the recent window, route edges |
| `scripts

/theme-tokens.mjs` | every `--dsw-*`/`--dsh-*` reference is declared by the installed bundle |
| `sc
ripts/visual-tokens.mjs` | no raw colours, radii/type from the theme scale, no infinite animation |
| `scripts/verify-deployed.mjs` | the running GUI serves the bundle and the state route |
## Limitations

- **Nothing before mount.** The Host folds the live event stream, so sessions that were already
idle

before it mounted do not appear — that is the intended meaning of a radar.
- **One Host process.**

Sessions in another client window or process are outside its view.
- **Read-only.** Rows switch sess

ions; the radar never stops, retries or approves anything.
- **Sub-agents are counted, not listed.**
Their rows belong to the parent session.
